benefits.title: Sealed until the moment you mix
benefits.text: The freeze-dried peptide sits in its own chamber, kept away from the liquid by a stopper. Nothing degrades on the shelf, nothing is mixed before you want it.

benefits.title: BAC water already in the cartridge
benefits.text: The second chamber holds the bacteriostatic water. No extra vials to buy, no measuring, no transfers. Everything you need ships in one box.

benefits.title: Precision counter, reusable pen body
benefits.text: The cartridge clicks into the VETUD pen with its counter window. Keep the pen, swap the cartridge. Clean, exact, and built to be used again.

items.a: After you place your order you get an email right away with the payment details and your order number. Nothing is charged on this page. Use your order number as the payment reference.
Orders ship within 24 hours of payment (business days), with a tracking number sent by email and, if you chose one, on your messaging app.

Two things. Purity: every lot is tested, and if a lot tests below 99% purity we refund it. Delivery: if your parcel is lost on the way, we reship it or refund you. Message us with your order number and we'll sort it out.
Each VETUD box holds one pen in the strength you chose, 12 disposable needles and an instruction booklet, labelled with the product and lot. The outer packaging is plain and discreet.

items.q: What's the difference between 20 mg and 40 mg?
items.a: The amount of peptide in the pen. The 40 mg pen costs less per mg, which is why it's marked Best value.

items.q: Can I get the certificate of analysis (COA)?
items.a: Yes. Every lot is tested for purity. Message us with your order number and we'll send the COA for the lot you received.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Yes, until it ships. Reply to your confirmation email or message us: {contacts}.
All products sold on this website are intended for research and identification purposes only. These products are not intended for human dosing, injection, or ingestion.
